newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes close weaker on pressure from products.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes close weaker on pressure from products.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes closed out a mild Wednesday session on the down side, losing ground on bearish sentiment in the products, traders said.
Outright crude prices had a difficult time sustaining momentum above the $24.00 a barrel level for the spot March, fading after topping above $24.20 on the NYMEX charts.
Cash markets featured a modest resurgence in Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, while sour grades continued to deal at weak prices in the face of substantial supplies.
March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing ended around 10 cents lower at $23.85-95 a barrel.
